notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
I'm going to upload the recent update today. It's mainly just bug fixes, and 20 new items based on player feedback.

The new items are:
* 2 new helmets
* 2 new swords
* 2 new masks
* World items: Bathtub, fridge, oven, TV radio, grandfather clock, couch, chair, grand piano, microwave, small lamp, hanging flowers, flower stand

The game isn't really making any income, so I'll just be working slowly on it in my free time (and eventually have an open sourced version released).

REMINDER: email /FB me if you need to get a hold of me.

 I don't get any alerts if you post in the discussion board, so I only see new activity if I'm browsing the developer portal to update the game, and browse through the game store.
